Title: MySQL
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-6.5/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-5
Content: MySQL is a widely used relational database management system. The JDBC connector can connect to a MySQL database to pull structure and lineage metadata. To leverage these capabilities, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to mysql. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to mysql.
